cues.text: The command room at the dorm. Everyone sits around the low table: you, Mitsuru and Akihiko on the sofa, Yukari, Fuuka and Junpei on stools facing you, and the chairman in an armchair. Mitsuru and Akihiko both have their arms folded.
Yukari gets to her feet, glaring at Mitsuru.
Yukari, Fuuka and Junpei start in shock.
